purpose: USES For the temporary relief of symptoms due to Seasonal Allergies such as: Sneezing, Watery Eyes, Runny nose
warnings: WARNINGS Stop use and ask doctor if symptoms worsen or persist more than 5 days
pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: PREGNANCY If pregnant or breast-feeding ask a doctor before use
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: WARNINGS Keep this and all medicines out of reach of children
dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Adults and children 12 years and older 2 sprays to each nostril , 3-5 times per day Children between 12 years and 6 years of age 1 spray to each nostril, 3-5 times per day Children under 6 years 1 spray to each nostril, 3 times per day
indications_and_usage: Tilt head slightly forward, place tip of bottle into nose, compress bottle once for each spray, aiming towards the back of the nose.
